local_bodies.source_label: Open Data Kerala LSG boundary snapshot, release 1.1.0 (OSM-derived, ODbL)
local_bodies.short_note: 78 community-mapped local bodies. 2,001 screened facility records, with road-boundary gaps retained in an unmatched row.
local_bodies.table_note: 70 gram panchayats, 7 municipalities and 1 corporation, plus an unmatched road-coverage row. These are community boundaries, not a surveyed statutory layer. Counts reflect mapped inventories and are not comparable vulnerability ratings.
method_paragraphs: Local-body polygons are the existing Open Data Kerala OSM-derived release 1.1.0 snapshot. They are not a current surveyed statutory boundary set.

The 70 gram panchayats, seven municipalities and one corporation match official administrative counts. Some names have spelling or transliteration differences; count agreement does not validate every boundary or identity.

Approximate area centres are derived from these polygons in UTM 43N: a centroid is used if inside the area, otherwise an inside-area representative point. These markers are not office locations, entrances, navigation destinations, shelters or flood-safe points.

Each screened facility is assigned once by its representative point. Its flood flag is calculated using full mapped geometry and the unchanged original KSDMA raster cells. An unmatched bucket preserves gaps rather than assigning them silently.

The health cohort is broader than in the earlier release. OSM hospital, clinic, centre, medical-practice and rehabilitation classes are shown separately in record details. The legacy hospitals_* data keys hold this broader health-record cohort, not a count of verified hospitals.
Roads are union-dissolved before measurement in UTM 43N. Exposure totals cover major-road classes, not every road. Boundary gaps are retained in the unmatched row.

Mapped overlaps describe exposure screening, not vulnerability, actual flood damage, operating status, disruption or safe access. Source dates and independent identity-check status are reported separately.

inventory_review.facilities_status: School and healthcare-tag snapshots refreshed. The wider amenity-health query failed; earlier hospital-tagged records are retained where needed. This is a partial source refresh, not a complete register or proof of current operation.
inventory_review.roads_status: Major-road source refresh succeeded. No tag or geometry changes were found in the 3,248 queried ways. The separate full-road query failed. Road operation and access were not independently checked.
inventory_review.facilities_source_time: Schools: 19 Oct 2026, 18:52 IST. Healthcare-tag branch: 19 Oct 2026, 18:52 IST. 61 retained hospital-tagged records: 19 Oct 2026, 15:51 IST.
inventory_review.note: Health types follow OSM tags, not an independently verified clinical classification. The health cohort now also includes clinics, centres, medical practices and rehabilitation records, so it must not be compared directly with the earlier hospital-tag-only totals. Most records have not been independently checked. The small official-source identity sample does not validate coordinates or current operation. Parking and animal-care candidates are held out for review. The amenity-only clinic/practice branch may be missing records. Google Maps content was not copied or used as an analytical input.
inventory_review.school_coverage: OSM amenity=school records, with duplicate screening; not an authoritative complete school register.
inventory_review.health_coverage: Broader human-health candidates from a fresh healthcare-tag branch plus retained earlier hospital-tagged records; amenity-only clinic/practice coverage is not confirmed complete.
inventory_review.road_coverage: Fresh major-road classes in exposure totals. All-road coverage is not established by the failed full-network query.
inventory_review.waterways_status: 8,364 previously acquired OSM waterway segments retained as context. A new query failed. They are not a complete drainage survey or a capacity assessment.
